claim: Evaluate option relative value through implied volatility, skew, term structure, Greeks, payoff structure and executable market-making constraints.
Build arbitrage-checked implied-volatility, skew and term surfaces from executable quotes.
Recompute Greeks and state-contingent payoff after spreads and contract conventions.
Reject relative value when quotes are stale or timestamps are inconsistent.
Reject apparent mispricing that cannot clear the executable spread.
Reject a structure whose material Greek or payoff exposure is not computed.
Excluded claim: stale mid-prices treated as executable
Excluded claim: directional equity judgments outside an option structure
Known limit: Professional market-making positions, inventory constraints and execution records are private.
Known limit: Educational examples simplify slippage, model risk and dynamic hedging relative to live markets.
